event_summary: An orange ball appears from the left, travels across a tabletop toward the right, and exits the frame while other visible objects remain stationary.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood-grain tabletop in front of a yellow couch. A small dark cylindrical object with an orange end rests near the back-center of the tabletop, and a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the left edge. After several still moments, an orange ball enters from the left side of the tabletop, moves steadily rightward across the visible surface, passes in front of the resting back-center object without visible contact, reaches the right edge, and disappears from view. The scene then remains still.

reasons: The tabletop, couch, and resting objects are visible before the moving orange ball enters.
The moving orange ball is not visible in the first frame.
